integrations.name: Gemma via Ollama
integrations.note: gemma3:4b full suite run locally: 2 pass / 10 fail, JSON tool mode (no native tool calling in Ollama). A 3-case rerun on 2026-10-18 gave the same verdicts, tool calls and final states (reply wording differed). Gemma 4 (gemma-4-31B-it) is only the hosted default and has not been called.

integrations.name: OpenAI-compatible backend
integrations.note: Run through Ollama's OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint with qwen3:8b: 2 of 2 cases pass, and the dummy API key appears in no artifact or log. This is the code path DigitalOcean inference uses, not a call to DigitalOcean.

integrations.name: DigitalOcean serverless inference
integrations.note: Request format checked against DigitalOcean's docs and a local stub. Not called: no model access key. DigitalOcean's model table does not list tool calling for gemma-4-31B-it, so the deploy configs use JSON tool mode.

integrations.name: Sentry agent tracing
integrations.note: gen_ai agent, chat and tool spans checked with the real sentry-sdk and an in-memory transport; error events carry no local variables (so no API key or utterance), and model/tool exceptions are captured. Not live-verified: no DSN.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs speech
integrations.note: TTS then STT per user turn, checked against ElevenLabs' API docs with fakes and a local HTTP stub. Not live-verified: no API key.

integrations.name: MongoDB export (Atlas pending)
integrations.note: Exported 3 bundled runs into a local MongoDB 7.0.45: idempotent re-export, indexes, per-case report, live test passing. Not yet run against an Atlas cluster.

integrations.name: Tiger Data export + similar-failure search (Tiger Cloud pending)
integrations.note: Local TimescaleDB 2.30.2 + pgvector 0.8.7 (PostgreSQL 16): hypertable export, idempotent, report, 22 failures embedded with local embeddinggemma, hybrid keyword + vector search. Not yet run on Tiger Cloud.

integrations.name: Temporal durable evaluation runs
integrations.note: Local Temporal dev server (CLI 1.9.1, Server 1.32.0): same summary as bolibench run; after kill -9 of the worker the interrupted case ran again (attempt 2) and the run completed; restarting the same workflow id re-ran nothing. The agent in the crash test was a slow stub. This makes the evaluation run durable, not the agent.

integrations.name: Mastra agent
integrations.note: examples/mastra-agent (@mastra/core 1.78.0) full suite on local qwen3:8b: 6 pass / 6 fail / 0 error. A 2-case rerun on 2026-10-18 gave the same verdicts and tool calls.

integrations.name: Backboard bridge
